teaser: The hum of a dentist office waiting room, fluorescent light and old magazines, and you already sense which patient in the row is nervous before the hygienist calls a name. That noticing is the shape of life path 11 meeting an INFJ. The 11 carries an intensity most numbers don't, a pull toward insight that arrives before explanation; the INFJ holds a similar instinct, quiet, turned toward other people's unspoken weather. Crossed, neither tempers the other much. What is particular here is how fast the noticing turns into weight carried for people who never asked you to carry it.
excerpt: The diner booth at closing, vinyl cold under your hands, and you're still turning over a thing a partner said an hour ago.
